current_annotation.reasoning_summary: The patient clearly articulates a desire for a healthy lifestyle as the primary driver for quitting, placing them firmly in the contemplation stage. An appropriate intervention involves exploring these motivations further and highlighting the tangible health benefits of cessation to reinforce their commitment.
